rationale: Zone 1 set to 82% of protected-line impedance (26.39 Ω) for underreach. Zone 2 covers protected line plus 55% of shortest backup line (L_BC). Zone 3 covers protected line plus 122.5% of longest backup line (L_BD) while remaining well below load-encroachment limit (121 Ω). Delays follow coordination windows with Zone 1 instantaneous, Zone 2 at 0.3 s, and Zone 3 at 0.85 s for remote backup.
